title: Cursor pagination
prompt: Change GET /notes in src/routes/notes.ts to cursor pagination: it takes an optional `cursor` query string and a `limit` (1 to 100, default 20) instead of `offset`, and returns { "items": [...], "nextCursor": string | null } with the current user's notes, newest first. Passing nextCursor back as cursor returns the next page, without skipping or repeating notes; an invalid cursor must answer 400.
